ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the RS-3,
Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District symbols and indications as shown on
Map No. 13-H in the area bounded by:

a line 53.04 feet north of and parallel to West Foster Avenue; North Paulina Street; West
Foster Avenue; and the alley next west of and parallel to North Paulina Street,

to those of a B2-2, Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.
SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.

OFT

Andre Vasquez
Alderman, —

Common Addresses:
1700-1706 W. Foster Avenue
